$comment: The native Astro site kit: each item, its files (paths under kit/; installed under src/kit/, endpoints under src/pages/), the npm packages it needs and the other items it uses. Install an item with npx shadcn@latest add https://www.themes.dev/astro/r/<name>.json

items.name: seo
items.title: SEO head
items.description: Title, description, canonical, robots, hreflang, Open Graph and the Twitter card, from one component in your layout's head.

items.name: json-ld
items.title: JSON-LD
items.description: Structured data as JSON-LD, with helpers for Organization, WebSite, Article, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage and Product.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Where the page sits, as links, with the BreadcrumbList structured data. The current page carries aria-current.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Numbered pages with previous and next for an archive from paginate(). 36px controls, gaps as an ellipsis.

items.name: toc
items.title: Table of contents
items.description: On this page: links to the h2 and h3 of an article, from Markdown headings or Portable Text.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip link
items.description: A link to the main content that appears on keyboard focus, as the first thing in the body.

items.name: figure
items.title: Figure
items.description: An image with a caption. Width, height and alt are required, so the page never jumps; local images go through astro:assets.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Long-form text in a 65-character measure on shadcn's tokens: headings, lists, quotes, tables, code and images, light and dark.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code highlighted at build time with Shiki, light and dark, with a file name and a copy button.

items.name: portable-text
items.title: Portable Text
items.description: Sanity's Portable Text as HTML through astro-portabletext, with headings that carry ids, links, images and code blocks.

items.name: time
items.title: Date
items.description: A date people can read, with the machine-readable value in datetime, formatted at build time.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: A 36px button that switches light and dark and remembers the choice, plus the head script that prevents a flash.

items.name: rss-feed
items.title: RSS feed
items.description: An /rss.xml endpoint from a content collection with @astrojs/rss.

items.name: llms-txt
items.title: llms.txt
items.description: An /llms.txt endpoint that lists your pages and posts for AI tools, built from your collections.

items.name: robots-txt
items.title: robots.txt
items.description: A /robots.txt endpoint with your sitemap's address and the paths to keep out of search.
